# external references

**Status:** REFERENCE ONLY — never production.

## What belongs here

Anything downloaded from the web for visual research: Wikimedia, Unsplash,
Pinterest, design archives, screenshots of other sites, mood-board material.

## Rules — read before adding anything

- This folder is **visual research only**. Nothing here may be used on the
  public Stencil landing page, in marketing, or in any shipped product
  surface — ever — unless it is separately, explicitly relicensed and moved
  through the provenance process in `assets/stencil/ASSET-MANIFEST.md`.
- Do not reference files from this folder directly in landing-page code,
  design mockups intended for production, or component source.
- Keep the original source URL alongside each file (e.g. a sibling `.txt`
  or a note in a local index) so provenance is traceable later if an asset
  is ever considered for relicensing.
- Assets here are **not automatically imported** into anything. Moving an
  asset out of this folder into a production directory is a deliberate,
  separate decision — not something that happens by default.
